content_descriptors.notes: This game contains horror elements, a dark atmosphere, blood, and occasional strong language. It does not include scenes of sexual content, drug use, or self-harm. The story explores dark themes such as trauma and the struggle for survival.

linux_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Ubuntu 12.04 LTS
  • Processor: 2.0Ghz Intel® Core™2 Duo Processor or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 9800 GT 512 MB Video Card or AMD equivalent
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: MacOS 11.3 or newer
  • Processor: Apple M1 Pro or better
  • Memory: 4 MB RAM
  • Graphics: Apple M1 Pro or better
  • Storage: 2 MB available space

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64bit
  • Processor: 2.0Ghz Intel® Core™2 Duo Processor or AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA 9800 GT 512 MB Video Card or AMD equivalent
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
